NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 8 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 1 · 11 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 1, 12:56 PM ET

The Bengals are the top-projected defense on the Week 8 DraftKings main slate at 7.7 DraftKings points for $3,800, against Tennessee. Jaguars (7.5, $3,700) and Steelers (7.4, $3,300) are next.

The Browns return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.34 projected points per $1,000 at $2,600.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 1, 12:56 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 8

Bengals, CIN vs TEN ($3,800)

Bengals carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.7 DraftKings points at $3,800. That is 0.3 points clear of Jaguars. The salary works out to 2.03 projected points per $1,000, 4th of 6 at the position. Across 10,000 simulations Bengals averaged 7.8 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cincinnati is a 13.5-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 30 in a game totaled at 46.5.

Value: Browns, CLE at PIT ($2,600)

Browns projects for 6.1 DraftKings points at $2,600, which works out to 2.34 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 6 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 10,000 simulations Browns averaged 6.2 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.6, and it holds 5% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Cleveland is a 3.5-point underdog on the road against Pittsburgh, with an implied team total of 17.5 in a game totaled at 38.5.
